text:
Marie: FYI — Brightforge (acct BF-992) got migrated to new pricing on 2026-03-01, but the legacy promo discount carried over incorrectly. Invoice INV-2026-045 charged $8,423.40, expected prorated $4,241.70. Need manual credit + reissued invoice. Support ticket #SUP-9843 opened.

Tony: Ack. Can you paste the invoice lines and the bill run ID?

Marie: Bill run: br-run-03-01-26
Invoice snippet:
```
INV-2026-045 | BF-992 | 03/01/2026 | Legacy Plan - base 12 mo @ $5000 | $5,000.00
INV-2026-045 | BF-992 | 03/01/2026 | Usage overage 42,346 tokens | $3,423.40
INV-2026-045 | BF-992 | 03/01/2026 | Legacy promo discount applied (100%) | -$0.00  <-- should not apply
```
Expected: prorated base $2,500 plus usage $1,741.70 => ~$4,241.70

Liz: @Marie tagging billing ops — looks like promo mapping rule `legacy-full-100` still hit post-migration. Suggested action: 1) Issue goodwill credit for difference $4,181.70, 2) Re-run invoice without promo and reissue, 3) Confirm GL entries. Approve? :thumbsup:

Tony: I'm good with that. Please route to Accounts Payable for credit memo. @billing-bot can you create CM for INV-2026-045 amount -$4,181.70 and link SUP-9843?

billing-bot: Created credit memo CM-2026-078 for -$4,181.70. Reissue queued (job br-reissue-171960). Estimated reissue ETA 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

Marie: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and close SUP-9843 once reissue is done. Note to ops: waive late fee if they already paid. :pray:
